title: Ramjet engine: safety relevance (R-10009)
description: Ramjet engine is a engine type. a duct with no moving parts that compresses air by forward motion; needs about Mach 0.5 to start and is efficient beyond Mach 3. Key specifications: moving parts: 0; efficient above: Mach 3. Safety practice around Ramjet engine follows directly from these characteristics. Related topics: supersonic, scramjet, duct.
